name: silo-task-control
description: A fast, focused control panel for finding, reviewing, and dispatching Codex tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Control Codex tasks from one panel.
interface.longDescription: SILO syncs Codex-native running state, shows durable batch history, and smart-selects tasks that should continue or receive a quality pass. Install silo-cn or silo-en to choose a fixed interface and prompt language.
defaultPrompt: 打开 SILO 控制面板，扫描我现在的 Codex 任务。
打开 SILO 外置面板。
列出所有可继续的任务，并让我选择继续或优化。
使用 SILO 智能选择，推荐应该继续或优化的任务。
检查最近的 Codex 任务状态，不要启动任何任务。
Open the SILO control panel and scan my current Codex tasks.
Use SILO Smart select and let me review the recommendations.
